title: He never flew a plane
summary: Goines asks about a plane; Hawkins says that was Jimmy Lunceford.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Okay. I would like to, sort of, now I think we have a pretty good idea of how all of that has sort of worked, and we have taken you way out on that musical tangent where you told us way back before that there were many things that were just as important to you in terms of your development - your sports and all of that. Something that came to mind is when you were talking about flying and you said that they couldn't get you in a plane. But, I thought that I read some place that you flew your own plane.
No, no, no. That's Jimmy Lunceford.
Cause after I had read this, I said no, that doesn't seem to fit in with that same kind of a thing. But, you don't go in for flying that way.
I get in there and that's it.
